import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout, QWidget
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.Expander(%PARENT%)
control.setHeaderText("Advanced options")
body = QWidget(control)
body_layout = QVBoxLayout(body)
body_layout.setContentsMargins(16, 12, 16, 14)
detail = fluentqt.Label("Enable background telemetry sync", body)
detail.setWordWrap(True)
body_layout.addWidget(detail)
control.setOwnedContentWidget(body)
control.setExpandedAnimated(True, False)
